title: A first note from the desk
summary: A placeholder post, so the notebook has something in it. Replace me.
html:
This is a sample post. It exists only so you can see how writing looks inside the notebook.

Write a new file in the posts folder, run the build, and it appears here.

What goes in a post

  • Plain paragraphs, like this one.
  • Headings, lists and emphasis.
  • Quotes:

A thousand miles begins with one step.

And a link back to the front door.
